newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT - Australian All Resources overbought.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Australian All Resources overbought.

text.p: ---------------(Analysis by Daniel Fock - Jun 19)-------------
*Near 1996 top at 1,531
*Leading indicators overbought
*Inside range day
*Resources index closed at 1,517.1 on Wednesday
The Australian All Resources index breaks range 1,470 to 1,505, just falling short of the 1,535 target, and 1996 high of 1,531.
Leading indicators are choppy and overbought, so traders will be increasingly cautious and will continue to employ trailing stops.
Thursday's move is likely to show the next direction.

Short term technical indicators are mixed. Averages are bullish. Leading indicators choppy and overbought. ROC is higher, likewise Stochastics. RSI is overbought and moving down. Bulls will increasingly become anxious, and keep trailing stops just below the recent range.
Especially with the closeness of the 1996 high of 1,531.
In the medium term, the index is also higher breaking from congestion.
Resistance is at 1,531 with the previous major higher, so traders will become more cautious.
Also the targeted extension from the consolidation at 1,535 was almost reached.
Current trendline support has risen to 1,470, so if the index fall below, traders are likely to sell.
Medium term technicals are bullish and overbought. Averages are bullish.
Leading indicators are overbought and moving higher. Traders are likely to continue to trade the bull channel, but focus on lower Fibonacci targets of 1,446, 1,421 and 1,396.
In the longer term, the index is approaching a double top at 1,531.
Bulls will become anxious if the index drops below 1,505, and will most likely lighten positions if the index falls below 1,450.
They, like the shorter term traders, are likely to be contemplating a retracement.

Longer term technicals are bullish to mixed. The averages are bullish. Leading technicals are mixed. ROC is lower than last month, with RSI and Stochastics higher. All indicators are higher than last week.

The extension target of 1,535 fell short by about 10 points, and the index failed to reach the 1996 high of 1,531 by four points. Leading indicators are overbought. The index has rallied very steeply with only a three week pause.
Wednesday's inside range day, shows the indecision amongst the players.
Still in the overall bull channels, the chance of retracement continues to grow.
Traders are most likely to remain long, but use trailing stops to trigger selling action.
Today's move is most likely to continue over the next week.
(Daniel Fock is a member of the Australian Technical Analysts Association. Views are his own.)
